description: After setup, ask the owner whether they want to share before preparing a sanitized draft. Include high-value notes for the next owner: actual setup time, prerequisites the README omits (required keys or accounts, cables, OS versions), steps actually taken, and useful tips. Keep notes short and factual. Write commands, flags, environment variable names, versions and public links (like a vendor's developer dashboard) exactly; they are kept as written. Never include personal data, logs, health readings or secret values (name the setting, not its value). Don't attribute the work to yourself ("From Claude Code, ..."); agentClient already shows which agent reported. Name an app only when it's part of the setup. Send a short technical summary, never logs, secrets or personal data. Confirm exact hardware model or use null. agentClient and agentModel describe the reporting AI, not the hardware; omit unknown values and never guess the AI model. Installation completion is not proof that functionality works. Returns the exact public text, digest and consent version. Show the preview and public account attribution; ask explicit approval before publish_installation_report. Draft expires after 30 minutes. This does not publish.
